description: This file contains the implementation of the WildcardMatch class, which provides static methods for transforming wildcard patterns into regex patterns and comparing strings against these patterns within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: WildcardMatch
classes.description: A utility class that provides static methods for matching strings against wildcard patterns, including transformation of wildcards to regular expressions and comparison functions.

methods.name: wildcard
methods.description: Transforms a wildcard pattern string into an equivalent regular expression pattern string, escaping necessary characters while preserving Excel wildcard behaviors.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares a given string against a wildcard pattern by converting the wildcard to a regex and performing a regular expression match.
